name: KRONOS_LIVE — weekly forecast generator for the FIVEWAY gate
what_it_is: Not a strategy and not a bot that trades. It runs the Kronos foundation model over a frozen
universe once a week and writes kronos_live.json, which fiveway_bot reads as one of its five
gates. It exists because the research forecasts stopped at 2026-07-17 and a forward test
reading them would silently gate today's trades on three-week-old predictions.
FIVEWAY refuses to emit at all if this file is more than 10 days old — verified by smoke test.
why_there_is_no_genome: The model is 4.6 billion pre-training bars of learned weights. There is no window and no
threshold to declare; MAX_CONTEXT=512 is a tensor size, not a strategy parameter.
why_it_cannot_run_in_the_village: It needs torch and a multi-gigabyte weights download, and it runs from a git clone of
shiyu-coder/Kronos at /app/Kronos. The court refuses that whole shape of file, correctly.

real_constants.hardware: CPU only, no GPU — about 200 forecasts a week

verdict_already_measured.headline: Eight independent tests of Kronos on this project's data. Eight nulls.
verdict_already_measured.arm_b: 200 stocks, weekly, 19,994 forecasts — RankIC +0.0008 (t=+0.05); median daily RankIC -0.0304, only 48% of days positive
verdict_already_measured.the_kill_test: Kronos cannot be distinguished from ITS OWN SIGNAL randomly permuted across names (z=+0.22, p=0.41 and z=+0.11, p=0.46). That is an information problem, not an adaptation problem.
verdict_already_measured.beaten_by: Free 12-1 momentum scored RankIC +0.0383 (t=+2.55) on the same 20 ETFs
verdict_already_measured.later_stacks: Also null inside the wheel gate (loses to its own shuffle placebo, p=0.86), the spidey stack, and the whale stack
verdict_already_measured.hard_boundary: Pre-training ends June 2024 and includes 4.6B US bars from 2000 onward — 38% of the corpus. Every US backtest before 2024-07 is inside the weights. The honest window can only grow by waiting.
verdict_already_measured.the_number_that_could_have_been_spun: Arm B's secondary endpoint read top-quartile +1.416%/10d, t=+2.05. It is not evidence: n=10 cohorts, pre-registered as secondary, underpowered, primary endpoint zero, kill criterion failed.

what_the_village_could_still_do: Nothing that would settle anything. If a village firm using this gate looks good, the
first hypothesis should be the village's data or cost model, not that Kronos works after all.
